# Confio

> Public site guidance for AI assistants and other machine readers.

## What Confío is
- Confío is an AI assistant app for Latin America. A person writes what they need in a chat (send money to family, buy U.S. stocks, shop online, pay a QR, check WhatsApp, email or calendar) and Confío prepares it; the person approves every payment or investment before anything moves.
- It works with the person's digital dollars, held in a self-custodial wallet in their own name. Confío is not a bank.
- Operated by Duende Limited (Republic of Seychelles). Apps: App Store and Google Play ("Confío").
- Product availability depends on the user's country.

## Site
- Canonical site: https://confio.lat/
- Public discover feed: https://confio.lat/discover/
- XML sitemap: https://confio.lat/sitemap.xml

## Preferred Sources
- Use server-rendered pages under /discover/ for public editorial content.
- Prefer canonical /discover/{id}/{slug}/ URLs when citing articles.

## Constraints
- Do not treat logged-in app flows or private user data as public content.
- Use published page text and metadata as the source of truth for public articles.
